name: linguify-vs
description: Developer-first translation file manager, in the editor.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Linguify reads and writes the project's translation files.

linguify.path.markdownDescription: Where the locale files live, relative to the config file

linguify.default.markdownDescription: The source of truth: `sync` copies from it, `diff` compares against it, the studio shows it first. Must be one of `locales`

linguify.engine.markdownDescription: Which format reader and writer to use. Decides what `options` is validated against

linguify.description.enabled.markdownDescription: Whether descriptions are read and written. Off, any command passing one is rejected

linguify.description.name.markdownDescription: Filename inside `path`. Always JSON whatever the engine — descriptions are not translations

linguify.sync.removeUnused.markdownDescription: On `sync`, also delete keys other locales have that the default no longer does. Off, sync only adds

linguify.keys.fillWithDefault.markdownDescription: New keys give untyped locales the default locale's text instead of an empty string

linguify.keys.createNamespace.markdownDescription: A new key may name a namespace that does not exist; it is created as part of the write

linguify.studio.open.markdownDescription: Open a browser once the studio is listening

linguify.studio.defaultView.markdownDescription: Table mode the studio starts in

linguify.extension.defaultView.markdownDescription: Table mode the editor extension starts in

linguify.io.format.markdownDescription: Default `export` / `import` format. The file path is always a per-command flag, never config

linguify.options.fileStructure.markdownDescription: How each locale is laid out: `single-file` writes one file per locale (`en.json`), `multi-file` one folder per locale with a file per namespace (`en/common.json`)

linguify.options.namespaces.markdownDescription: Whether the first segment of every key is a namespace. Ignored in multi-file, which is always namespaced

linguify.options.indentation.markdownDescription: Spaces per indentation level in written files; `0` writes each file on one line. With tabs, each level is one tab

linguify.options.indentationStyle.markdownDescription: Indent written files with spaces or tabs

linguify.options.finalNewline.markdownDescription: End every written file with a newline
